newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI intervention pushes up fwd dlr premia.
newsitem.headline: India RBI intervention pushes up fwd dlr premia.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) resumed its forward dollar purchases on Thursday, pushing up the premia, dealers said.
"They are buying outright forwards again," said a dealer at a European bank's Bombay office.
September dollar premium was quoted at 1.33/1.36 rupees in latest deals, up from the opening level of 1.28/1.31 rupees.
The RBI has been buying dollars in recent months to arrest the rupee's rise against the U.S. currency.
The spot dollar was quoted at 35.85/86 in latest deals.
